decisions.reason: This app is very close to our core practice software and regulatory workflow knowledge, and its dedicated market presence suggests we can keep learning from customers and improve it with our in-house R&D.

A continuing education offer builds on our existing training content, customer relationships, and practitioner knowledge, so it is related enough to our capabilities to remain a useful complement to the core business.
Remote screen sharing support is tightly linked to our established support and software implementation capabilities, making it easy for us to absorb user feedback and apply improvements commercially.
The analytics dashboard directly extends our installed software base and data integration know-how, giving us strong absorptive capacity to refine and monetize it.
A complete dental practice bundle is very close to our established modular offer and fits our broad portfolio strategy, so it should benefit strongly from our existing knowledge and sales channels.

The job and practice listing portal is comparatively distant from our software and support knowledge base, and its limited market signalling suggests weaker ability to learn, scale, and improve it than our more related products.
